Series 4 is the most advanced evolution of the PERGOLUX range to date, bringing a range of premium features and improvements across all models.

One of the biggest upgrades is the introduction of RapidLouver™ technology, a patent-pending click-in system that significantly speeds up installation. Compared to Series 3, roof assembly time has been reduced by up to 75%, making installation faster and more straightforward than ever.

All Series 4 models now come standard with SnapFIT accessory rails, making it easier to add screens, glass walls, lighting and other accessories without the need for drilling or modifications to the frame. The Pro Max model also includes an additional SnapFIT rail integrated into the posts for even greater flexibility.
The Pergola 4 Pro and Pro Max feature an upgraded drip guard system, designed to reduce operating noise and improve water management during wet weather.

For motorised models, Bluetooth connectivity has been enhanced with improved range and more reliable performance, providing a smoother user experience when controlling your pergola through the app or smart home integrations.

The Pergola 4 Pro Max is now available in the full range of standard sizes and can be configured as either a freestanding or wall-mounted pergola, offering more design flexibility than previous premium models.
Like Series 3, every Series 4 pergola is backed by the same 10-year PERGOLUX warranty, giving you long-term confidence in your investment.
The PERGOLUX Series 4 range includes three models, each designed to suit different needs and lifestyles.

PERGOLUX Pergola 4 is the manually operated model, featuring an adjustable louvre roof controlled by a hand crank. With no motors, wiring or electricity required, it offers a simple and reliable solution for outdoor living. It includes a SnapFIT accessory rail on each beam, is compatible with optional LED lighting and heating accessories, and is engineered for outstanding durability.

PERGOLUX Pergola 4 Pro adds motorised operation and integrated lighting. Control the louvre roof via remote, Bluetooth app or your smart home system. Dimmable LED lighting is built into the beams and is available in warm white or RGB. The Pro also features an additional SnapFIT rail on each beam, providing greater flexibility for accessories and customisation.

PERGOLUX Pergola 4 Pro Max is our premium motorised model. It includes all the smart features of the Pro, while offering larger 150 x 150 mm posts, wider louvres for a more open outlook, integrated dimmable LED lighting within the louvres, and spans of up to 6 metres without the need for a centre post. Its robust design delivers exceptional strength and performance for larger outdoor spaces.

All Series 4 pergolas are manufactured from premium 6063-T5 aluminium with a durable double-layer powder-coated finish. Every model features the integrated RainLUX drainage system, adjustable louvres with up to 120° rotation, and compatibility with PERGOLUX glass walls, screen blinds, louvred walls and outdoor heating accessories.

In most cases, Pergolux Pergolas do not require planning permission, but requirements can vary depending on state, property type, size, and location. Some councils may classify a pergola as a temporary outdoor structure, while others may request formal approval.
It is always recommended to check with the local council to confirm what applies to your property. For further guidance, contact the Pergolux team via live chat, email, or phone 7 days a week.
